BannerConfig.title: BannerConfig
BannerConfig.description: Public promotional announcement banner configuration displayed at the top of the Stamp pen storefront.

isActive.description: Whether the announcement banner is currently visible to storefront visitors.

text.description: Primary promotional text displayed inside the banner.

ctaLabel.description: Optional action link label shown next to the banner message.

ctaTarget.description: Destination target when the banner action link is clicked.

theme.description: Visual color theme for the announcement banner.

dismissible.description: Whether storefront visitors can dismiss the banner.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last banner update.

updatedBy.description: UID of the authenticated admin who updated the banner.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized store administrator record keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was recorded.

/site_settings/{settingId}.description: Storefront configuration documents (currently 'banner' document). Publicly readable for get on 'banner'; writable only by verified admins.

/admins/{userId}.description: Authorized admin UIDs. Readable by the owning user or admins; writable only by existing bootstrapped admins.
